svg.title: MediaLog — Endless loop
svg.desc: Twenty-two shaded spheres ride an endless figure-eight between two hairlines, larger as they swing nearer — a timeline that keeps going. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The blitter-bob chain on a Lissajous path becomes a loop with no beginning or end; One navy ramp with a white highlight replaces the copper blue; the rainbow hairlines become steel and tan.
